ancestries.name: Human
ancestries.description: All skills gain +1.

ancestries.name: Dwarf
ancestries.description: +2 maximum Hit Dice and +1 maximum Wound; Speed decreases by 1. Learn Dwarvish with INT 0 or higher.

ancestries.name: Elf
ancestries.description: +1 Speed and roll Initiative with advantage. Learn Elvish with INT 0 or higher.

ancestries.name: Halfling
ancestries.description: +1 Stealth. Once per Safe Rest, turn a failed save into a success.

ancestries.name: Gnome
ancestries.description: Free Reaction, Reach 6: let an ally reroll a die. The ability refreshes when healing takes you to full HP. −1 Speed; INT 0 or higher grants Dwarvish (called Gnomish).

ancestries.name: Dragonborn
ancestries.description: +1 Defense. Once per Safe Rest, split LVL + KEY bonus damage among the targets of one attack. Taking a Wound also refreshes this ability. Learn Draconic with INT 0 or higher.

ancestries.name: Goblin
ancestries.description: After an attack or hostile effect targets you and damage is resolved, move up to 2 spaces without spending an action or counting Difficult Terrain. Learn Goblin with INT 0 or higher.

ancestries.name: Orc
ancestries.description: Once per Safe Rest, stay at LVL HP instead of falling to 0 HP. +1 Might; INT 0 or higher grants Goblin (called Orcish).

ancestries.name: Kobold
ancestries.description: Advantage on dragon-related skill checks and Influence checks with friendly targets. Once per encounter, make an enemy reroll a noncritical attack against you. Learn Draconic with INT 0 or higher.

ancestries.name: Fiendkin
ancestries.description: Treat one neutral save as advantaged. Learn Infernal with INT 0 or higher.

ancestries.name: Bunbun
ancestries.description: Once per encounter, hop up to your Speed in any direction for free before you Interpose or after damage from an attack you Defended against.

ancestries.name: Birdfolk
ancestries.description: You can fly in Leather armor or lighter. Critical hits against you are Vicious: the attacker rolls an extra die.

ancestries.name: Celestial
ancestries.description: Treat your disadvantaged save as neutral. Learn Celestial with INT 0 or higher.

ancestries.name: Changeling
ancestries.description: Gain 2 shifting skill points. Spend 10 minutes to look like another ancestry; when you change, you may reassign both points to a single skill.

ancestries.name: Crystalborn
ancestries.description: Once per encounter when you Defend, add KEY to Defense and deal KEY damage to the attacker, bypassing their Defense.

ancestries.name: Dryad/Shroomling
ancestries.description: When you suffer at least one Wound, Daze every adjacent enemy. Learn Elvish with INT 0 or higher.

ancestries.name: Half-Giant
ancestries.description: Once per encounter, make an enemy reroll a crit against you. +2 Might; INT 0 or higher grants Dwarvish (called Giant).

ancestries.name: Minotaur/Beastfolk
ancestries.description: Move at least 4 spaces to optionally Knockback one creature in your path by 1 space.

ancestries.name: Oozeling/Construct
ancestries.description: Increase your Hit Die one step (d4 → d6 → d8 → d10 → d12 → d20). Hit Dice heal their maximum; magical healing heals its minimum.

ancestries.name: Planarbeing
ancestries.description: −2 maximum Wounds. When you Defend, you may take 1 Wound to phase out and bypass all effects of that attack.

ancestries.name: Ratfolk
ancestries.description: +1 Speed. Gain +2 Defense if you moved on your previous turn.

ancestries.name: Stoatling
ancestries.description: Single-target attacks between you and a larger creature add one d6 per size category of difference, regardless of which of you attacks.

ancestries.name: Turtle/Stonefolk
ancestries.description: Defense increases by 4 and Speed decreases by 2.

ancestries.name: Wyrdling
ancestries.description: Once per encounter when you or a willing ally within Reach 6 casts a tiered spell, you can have that caster roll on the Chaos Table.

backgrounds.name: Back Out of Retirement
backgrounds.description: Take 1 Wound to use an ability or spell as if you were one level higher. Your maximum Wounds decrease by 1.

backgrounds.name: Devoted Protector
backgrounds.description: Designate one party ally. While they are nearby, your maximum Wounds increase by 3. Whenever they suffer a Wound, so do you.

backgrounds.name: Academy Dropout
backgrounds.description: Learn one Utility Spell of your choice.

backgrounds.name: Made a BAD Choice
backgrounds.description: Start with 500 or 1,000 extra gold or a GM-approved uncommon or rare item, balanced by a curse or enemy. The GM may also permit a second background.

backgrounds.name: Haunted Past
backgrounds.description: You hear voices that sometimes offer useful or misleading advice. Roll with advantage against fear.

backgrounds.name: Ear to the Ground
backgrounds.description: Advantage when gathering or recalling gossip about near-future events or events from less than a year ago.

backgrounds.name: What? I’ve Been Around
backgrounds.description: Once per location (or at GM discretion), name a contact who can help. Roll a d20: 1–5 hostile; 6–12 you owe a debt; 13–19 willing if persuaded; 20 devoted admirer.

backgrounds.name: Acrobat
backgrounds.description: A larger ally can throw you especially far. You resist damage from falls and forced movement.

backgrounds.name: Wild One
backgrounds.description: Wild creatures are more approachable. +1 Naturecraft; Hit Dice heal an extra KEY HP when you Field Rest in the wild.

backgrounds.name: Fey Touched
backgrounds.description: Subtract 10 from magical damage you take, but add 10 to damage from metal weapons.

backgrounds.name: Survivalist
backgrounds.description: Always find your own rations. +1 maximum Hit Die and advantage on saves against poison. Once per Safe Rest, remove poison from yourself.

backgrounds.name: Home at Sea
backgrounds.description: Double HP and Wound recovery when resting aboard a ship or near water. You can substitute as first mate or captain and have advantage on water-related skill checks.

backgrounds.name: At Home Underground
backgrounds.description: Dig at double speed. Underground Safe Rests count as Lavish. Resting in the rain requires an INT save.

backgrounds.name: Raised by Goblins
backgrounds.description: Speak Goblin as a native. Automatically spot and avoid crude traps, and roll with advantage to detect or disarm more complex traps.

backgrounds.name: (Former) Con Artist
backgrounds.description: Forge most documents, imitate voices convincingly, and find criminal contacts in most major cities. Your reputation can initially work against you.

backgrounds.name: History Buff
backgrounds.description: Roll Lore with advantage for subjects or events more than a century old.

backgrounds.name: (Secretly) Undead
backgrounds.description: Ignore disease; you have no need to eat, drink, or breathe. Your presence unsettles children, animals, and Celestials.

backgrounds.name: Taste for the Finer Things
backgrounds.description: Know upper-class customs, fashions, and possibly secrets. Roll Influence with advantage when dealing with that social class.

backgrounds.name: Fearless
backgrounds.description: Immune to Frightened. Increase Initiative by 1 and decrease Defense by 1.

backgrounds.name: So Dumb I’m Smart Sometimes
backgrounds.description: Requires starting INT 0 or lower. Twice per Safe Rest, reroll a failed INT skill check or save with advantage.

backgrounds.name: Wily Underdog
backgrounds.description: Requires starting STR 0 or lower. Twice per Safe Rest, reroll a failed STR attack, STR save, or Might check using a different stat.

backgrounds.name: Bumblewise
backgrounds.description: Requires starting WIL 0 or lower. On a WIL-related roll, treat a total of 1 or less as a natural 20.

backgrounds.name: Accidental Acrobat
backgrounds.description: Requires starting DEX 0 or lower. You can retry failed DEX rolls, but failing the retry makes the consequences worse.

backgrounds.name: Tradesman/Artisan
backgrounds.description: Name a profession. You retain its specialist knowledge and have advantage on checks related to that work.
